hypothesis: The exact v51 three-block host has learned routing and coarse semantic order but lacks reliable carriage of arbitrary prompt token identities into autonomous output. A sparse rank-32 prompt-position pointer trained with explicit balanced copy/no-copy gate supervision and positive-position attention supervision can repair this localized failure without changing any v51 parameter or adding transformer depth.

historical_negative_control.result: rank-32 mixture-likelihood-only pointer changed zero of 1,400 held-out outputs
historical_negative_control.non_repeat_change: v52 keeps rank 32 but replaces the underdetermined mixture-only objective with direct balanced gate labels and direct matching-position attention loss; it is integrated with v51 persistent route controls and trains no parent parameter

architecture_lock.copy_distribution_support: only token IDs physically present in the prompt
architecture_lock.gate_conditioning: current hidden state plus selected canonical task route
architecture_lock.persistent_prompt_state: prompt keys are computed once at prefill and retained through incremental decoding

loss_lock.mixture_nll: teacher-forced probability mixture over frozen LM vocabulary and prompt-position pointer
loss_lock.balanced_gate_supervision: equal mean weight for response targets present versus absent in the prompt
loss_lock.positive_pointer_attention_supervision: negative log summed attention probability over prompt positions carrying the response target token

evaluation_order: focused tests and an exact-zero-parent-mutation CUDA precheck
CPU autonomous natural screen requiring at least 9 of 28 and zero collapse
CPU 1,400-case suite requiring every capability at least 0.80, retention at least 0.90, and zero collapse
only after quality passes: native export, graph identity, physical sparse execution, CPU throughput, TTFT, RSS, persistent-state, and repeated timing
decision_rule: Reject v52 without nearby rank, gate-weight, learning-rate, or duration sweeps if the natural screen fails, any full-suite capability remains below 0.80, retention is below 0.90, collapse is nonzero, any parent tensor changes, or the later exact runtime fails the 2x optimized-transformer CPU gate. If the pointer remains dormant, close prompt-pointer carriage; if it activates but corrupts open-ended English, use prompt-relative activation selectivity—not another scalar sweep—to identify the next mechanism.
